title: Determination of grade
jurisdiction: British Columbia (specific local authority not named in published decision)

facts.text: An existing single-family house sits on the high part of a steeply sloping lot. A two-storey addition at the low part contains a garage with living space above; the south wall has an overhead and swing door and ground slopes down toward the street.
The appellant characterized the full south wall as a localized depression, producing a three-storey count; the local authority used the average finished ground at that wall and counted four storeys.
The cited definition of grade uses average finished ground adjoining each exterior wall, with localized depressions excluded.
